transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I came in because... I just can't seem to shake this heavy, hopeless feeling. It's like, um... it feels like everything I built up after my divorce has just collapsed, and I’m just sitting under it all. I just don't know how to get out from under it.
How long have you been feeling this heavy, hopeless way?
It's been... about a month now. Yeah, roughly a month. It really started hanging over me right around the time I was dealing with all the financial mess after the divorce.
Since these feelings began, have you lost interest in or stopped enjoying activities that you usually enjoy?

Um, no, I wouldn't say that. I still do the things I usually like... I haven't really stopped my normal activities or anything. It's more just that I have this heavy feeling hanging over me while I do them. But my actual interest in things hasn't really changed, as far as I've noticed.
How has your sleep been since these feelings began?

It hasn't been good. Um, lately, I either just lie awake staring at the ceiling, replaying all the bills and work mistakes in my head... or I wake up way before dawn and feel like I never actually slept at all.
Have you had any thoughts of killing yourself or not wanting to be alive?

Yeah, I have. Um... I've just been thinking lately that it would be a lot easier if I didn't wake up. The thoughts actually got intense enough recently that I scared myself... which is why I ended up calling the employee assistance program at my job.
Since these feelings began, have you noticed a significant decrease in your energy?.

Yeah, I definitely have. Um... getting through a normal workday just feels like I'm dragging wet concrete. It's exhausting. Even doing the basics... like taking a shower or just opening my laptop to start the day, it takes way more energy than I seem to have right now.
Have you been having trouble concentrating or making decisions compared with before these feelings began?

Yes, definitely. Um, at work, I'll look at a basic drainage calculation or a spreadsheet I’ve used for years, and my mind just completely blanks. I just sit there... rereading the same numbers over and over. And even if I do process it, I can't seem to trust any decision I make with them. It's really frustrating.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least four days when you felt unusually elevated or irritable compared with your usual self?

Yeah, I have. Um... right before this recent crash, actually. I was either feeling weirdly wired and totally convinced that everything was finally clicking into place, or... I was just really on edge. Like, I was snapping at people in meetings over tiny comments that normally wouldn't bother me at all. It definitely lasted for a few days like that.
During that wired period, did you sleep less than usual without feeling tired the next day?

Yes, I did. Um... for several nights in a row, I think I only slept maybe two or three hours. And I didn't feel tired at all. I actually felt sharp enough to just keep working right through the next day. It honestly felt like sleeping was just an inefficient use of my time when I had so much I could be getting done.
How many consecutive days did that wired or unusually irritable period last?
Um, it's been going on for about two weeks now. Just this... out-of-control shift from being intensely wired to suddenly crashing.
